version.changelog: This release updates the server only. The bridge script remains at version 1.9.1 and does not need to be redeployed. Fixed: - render_project rendered the entire project when given only part of a range. With only start_time, only end_time, or an end_time at or before start_time, the tool ignored the range. It now renders from start_time to the end of the project, or from the start of the project to end_time, as its description states, and it returns an error when end_time is not later than start_time. tail_seconds still extends the render past the end. - Render and measurement timeouts named the wrong setting. When render_project, measure_loudness or measure_spectrum timed out, the error advised raising REAPER_FILE_TIMEOUT (default 5 seconds). These tools wait for REAPER_RENDER_TIMEOUT (default 600 seconds), and the error now names that setting. --help now lists REAPER_RENDER_TIMEOUT. - Installing from requirements.txt could install an incompatible MCP library. The file allowed version 2 of the mcp package, which removed the mcp.server.fastmcp module the server is built on, so a source installation failed at startup. requirements.txt now requires mcp>=1.2.0,<2.0, as the package does. - Failed deletions returned no explanation. delete_marker, delete_region and delete_send returned ok: false without an error when the marker, region or send did not exist. They now report what was not found, for example "No marker numbered 7". Every tool now includes an error whenever it returns ok: false. - test_connection.py used a Windows-only path to the bridge directory. It now locates the directory the same way the server does. - save_fx_preset and render_region were presented as working. Both tools always return an error: REAPER's API cannot save a named FX preset, and render_region is not implemented. Their descriptions and the README now say so. To render a region, use render_project with the region's start and end from get_regions. Added: - Python 3.14 support. The server is tested on Python 3.14, and the package lists it as supported. Changed: - Unknown command-line options are refused. A mistyped option such as --instal-bridge previously started the server, which then waited for a client. The command now prints its usage and exits with status 2.
